newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian bonds edge higher in quiet trade.
newsitem.headline: Austrian bonds edge higher in quiet trade.

text.p: 1640 GMT - Austrian bond futures were moderately firmer in quiet trade on Monday and traders pinpointed buying interest for the most recent five and 10-year issues.
Market looking for foreign leads, dealers said.
* 10 year benchmark 5.875 pct bond maturing July 2006 up five bps at 99.75 to yield 5.66 pct (5.66) in bourse trade, quoted post-market at 99.81/91 to yield 5.65/63.
* Latest five-year 4.375 bond maturing February 2002 closed down five bps at 98.40 in bourse trade, quoted post-market at 99.81/91 to yield 4.69/4.67 percent (4.68).
* AGB future up six bps at 108.60 on turnover of 80 lots.
* 10-year spread over Germany up steady at minus one bps, five-year spread up three at nine bps.
* Money market rates mixed with three-month VIBOR steady at 3.300 and overnight money slightly higher at 3.08/3.33. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 53112 257
